Title: Woodlands Dark and Days Bewitched: A History of Folk Horror
Synopsis: A sweeping documentary cataloguing the global history of folk horror cinema - from British classics to world traditions - exploring the primal dread rooted in landscape - community and ancient ritual.

Title: Zack Snyder's Justice League
Synopsis: A four-hour superhero epic in which Batman and Wonder Woman assemble a team of heroes to stop the alien conqueror Steppenwolf from unleashing catastrophic destruction on Earth with three ancient Mother Boxes.
